package.name: sbgc_interfaces
package.description:
Messages, services and actions for SimpleBGC32 gimbal control.
Deliberately small. Anything a standard ROS type can express is published as that type instead — joint angles as sensor_msgs/JointState, the board IMU as sensor_msgs/Imu, battery as sensor_msgs/BatteryState, health as diagnostic_msgs/DiagnosticArray, angle targets as control_msgs/FollowJointTrajectory. What remains here is board identity, driver and link status, control-mode selection, and gyro calibration.
This package depends on no other package in the repository, so a client that only needs to talk to the driver never has to build the serial code.
